## Checklist

- [ ] One task, atomic commits, Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:cov` (100%) and `npm run test:tooling` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` run, and `template.tpl` committed with its sources
- [ ] Permissions still the narrowest the code needs; the script URL still pinned to an exact version
- [ ] Behavior verified by running the tag code against a real tracker build
- [ ] README updated when touched; `metadata.yaml` gets a new version only for a submission
- [ ] Nothing personal can reach an event through this change
